rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a day-5 expanded blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona consistent with 3AA; minor overinterpretation from a single image and slight ambiguity around calling it full/early-expanded.
Strong integration of age, BMI, ovarian response, prior cycle history, semen parameters, endometrium, and untested status with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and mostly consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor looseness in distinguishing implantation, clinical pregnancy, and live birth rates.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading and standard IVF practice, including single good-quality blastocyst transfer counseling, luteal support, no bed rest, and selective rather than routine PGT-A in a 21-year-old; slight overconfidence in some prognostic framing.
Provides clear practical recommendations for current transfer management, lifestyle optimization, metabolic review, and contingency planning if future transfers fail.
